segments.narration: A stranger paid cash for a monument and disappeared. Elbert County, Georgia, nineteen seventy-nine.
What went up was six metres of granite: four upright slabs, a centre column and a capstone, weighing over a hundred tonnes.
Each face carried the same ten precepts in a different language. Eight languages in total, from English to Swahili to Hindi.
It worked as an instrument too. A hole tracked the North Star, a slot marked the solstices, and a shaft lit the date at noon.
On the sixth of July twenty twenty-two someone blew up one slab. The county demolished the rest that afternoon for safety, and nobody has been charged.
